profile.headline: Data-Driven | Globally Minded | Texas MBA
profile.summary: I am a brand manager that epitomizes the saying, "Think Globally, act locally." With 6 years of CPG industry experience working in both the United States and Japan, I am the perfect candidate to lead your brand to growth. I have worked in all aspects of the value chain, from operations to sales, giving me a broad understanding of the CPG business and making me an ideal brand manager.

positions.title: Ecommerce Consultant
positions.description:
• Spearheaded research for direct to consumer strategy for Waterloo Sparkling Water

• Created marketing strategy to launch new business line, including product line up, pricing, and digital promotion

• Collaborated with supply chain, marketing, finance, and online commerce platforms to build out strategy for the company executives

positions.title: MBA Marketing Intern - Alienware Communications
positions.description:
•	Created communications strategy to further establish Alienware’s position as the best PC for gaming, increasing favorability and share of voice in media
•	Collaborated with agency partners and championed plan to implement an influencer event for Dell G Series, setting of an influencer program for the brand

positions.title: Operational Cost Analyst
positions.description:
•	Brought together operations and finance teams to develop midterm plan to increase cash flow and decrease debt of subsidiary distillery; increased cash by an equivalent of $4M in five years preventing threat of bankruptcy 
•	Created and analyzed monthly cost reports for Japanese white spirits; identified and neutralized rising costs via operational efficiencies to achieve net-zero inflation
•	Spearheaded plan to reduce dry goods inventory by repurposing ingredients and cut purchasing resulting in $1M decrease on balance sheet in 2018

positions.title: Internal Communications Manager Japan
positions.description:
•	Promoted cross-cultural communication training for each existing and new Beam Suntory executive, including intensive English training for Japanese executives and acclimatization trip to smooth post-merger integration
•	Increased engagement of Japanese workforce by 15% by creating content relevant to Japanese audience and improving accuracy of Japanese language messaging
•	Supported Japanese and American leadership to formulate cohesive and coherent global strategy

positions.title: Assistant Brand Manager, International Liquors
positions.description:
•	Supervised marketing and sales activities of partner ABCK Corp. increasing Suntory’s U.S. sales by 5%
•	Coordinated design teams in the U.S. and production teams in Japan to launch Suntory’s first premium white spirit, Ao Vodka, selling 400 cases in New York City in initial year

positions.title: International Business Development Associate
positions.description:
•	Collaborated with internal and external partners to negotiate Suntory’s own route-to-market and increased product portfolio in the U.S. adding 3 brands and decreasing Suntory dependence on competitors
•	Procured and analyzed global spirits data to report market trends to leadership

educations.schoolName: The University of Texas at Austin
